sum: Three or four days on foot from the Pokhara lakeside: along the ridge to Bhumdi and Panchase Bhanjyang, up stone steps to the top at 2,517 m, and out by Bhadaure to Kande.
reach: By tourist bus (7–9 hours) or by air (about 25 minutes).

guide.note: Panchase lies in a protected forest outside the Annapurna Conservation Area, and no permit post on this route checks for a guide. One is still worth having on a first trek: the forest between Bhumdi and the Bhanjyang has unmarked forks and few people to ask, and it is not a place to walk alone. A guide also knows which family lodges are open.

access: The walk starts from the Pokhara lakeside itself: a rowing boat across Phewa Lake to the foot of the pagoda hill, or a taxi to the car park just below the stupa. It ends on the Baglung highway at Kande, about an hour from Pokhara by bus or taxi. A dirt road also reaches Bhadaure, where local buses and jeeps leave for the city.

photo.a: Phewa Lake lies below green, terraced hills, with the white wall of the Annapurna range and the pointed peak of Machhapuchhre across the skyline under a deep blue sky.
photo.c: Phewa Lake and the Annapurna range from the World Peace Pagoda ridge

transportText: Tourist bus between Kathmandu and Pokhara both ways, and a taxi back from Kande shared by two
transportExtra: the boat across Phewa Lake at the start
tips: Cross the lake by eight on the first morning, so that the day's walking is over by early afternoon.
A taxi to the pagoda car park cuts out the first 300 m of steps. It is a sensible choice if stairs are your weak point.
Carry a head torch and a warm jacket for the summit morning; from November to February it is close to freezing on top at dawn.

We found no permit or entry fee for this route, which stays south of the conservation area. Some agencies add an ACAP permit all the same; you need one only if you go on north of the highway, where permits are checked at Pothana.
Bring cash from Pokhara. There is no cash machine on the route, and lodges cannot change large notes.

days.t: Pokhara to Bhumdi by the World Peace Pagoda
days.note: Cross Phewa Lake by boat and climb about 300 m on stone steps through forest to the pagoda, 45 minutes to an hour. From there the way follows the ridge west past the tall Shiva statue at Pumdikot, partly on a quiet road, with the lake below on your right, to the lodges at Bhumdi.

A steady day along the ridge that ends about 500 m higher, with ups and downs on the way: first past scattered farms, then through thick forest. Much of it follows a rough jeep track with footpath shortcuts. Tea shops are few, so carry lunch and water. Published distances run from 7 to 14 km.

n: Mount View Greenland Hotel And Resort

days.t: Panchase Peak at sunrise, down to Bhadaure
days.note: Start an hour and a half before sunrise with a head torch: about 450 m of stone steps through mossy forest to the temple and viewpoint. Go back to the lodge for breakfast, or carry your bag over the top. Either way the path then drops along the forested north ridge to Bhadaure, steeply in places.

days.t: Bhadaure to Kande, drive to Pokhara
days.note: A short last morning along the ridge, on the dirt road and the paths beside it, with Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre ahead of you. Kande is on the highway, an hour from Pokhara by bus or taxi. If you would sooner not walk, the local bus or a jeep leaves from Bhadaure itself.
